title: Diverse Weight Averaging for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
mechanism: Average weights of independent runs with different hyperparameters from a shared init; weight averaging helps most when the input distribution shifts.
adaptation: Fork 8 runs from one PF checkpoint varying lr, Dice weights, synthetic half-cut views, Skeleton Recall 0.1; average weights for one E1-robust model.
min_experiment: Arm: DiWA of 8 forks. Baseline: their output ensemble and singles. Metric: E1 relF1@2, test crack IoU. Kill: DiWA below mean single.
evidence: R: improves state of the art on DomainBed without inference overhead; bias-variance-covariance-locality decomposition.
